description: An aerial photograph depicting irrigated fruit tree plantations in Morhamam, Anatolia, Turkey, captured by the Spot 5 satellite on 2011-06-29. The imagery uses a Near-Infrared (NIR), Red (R), Green (G) band combination. In this band combination, actively vegetated areas, such as the fruit tree rows, appear in shades of red and magenta, indicating healthy plant growth. The landscape consists of multiple, distinctly rectangular agricultural parcels. Many parcels exhibit clear linear patterns within them, consistent with rows of intensively managed fruit trees. Other areas appear in bluish-green or grey tones, indicating less vigorous vegetation or bare ground. Darker linear features demarcate field boundaries or irrigation channels. The image has a spatial resolution of 2.5 metres. The copyright is held by CNES 2011, with distribution by Airbus DS/Spot Image.
